mapper.insert: insert into document(file_name, file_suffix, file_size, minio_path, upload_user_id, process_status, update_user_id) values(#{fileName}, #{fileSuffix}, #{fileSize}, #{minioPath}, #{uploadUserId}, #{processStatus}, #{uploadUserId})
mapper.select: select id from document where file_name = #{objectName} and process_status = 'done'
select id from document where file_name = #{fileName} and minio_path = #{path} and process_status = 'done'
mapper.update: update document set process_status = 'deleted', update_time = NOW(), update_user_id = #{userId} where id = #{fileId}
